title: northstar-weave-and-tactical-scheduler-v0-1
content:
Purpose:
A compact operational playbook that weaves the northstar narrative into a tactical 30/60/90 schedule for company alignment, exec updates, and the next all-hands. Intent is to produce a single concise artifact teams can reference when preparing slides, comms, and OKR drafts.

TL;DR (for founders/executive reviewers):
- Focus cluster for the next quarter: predictable inference economics (latency p95, unit cost improvements), Dedicated capacity maturity, and Private deployment adoption for regulated accounts.
- Draft OKRs below aim to drive measurable revenue enablement and repeatability for onboarding Dedicated/Private customers.
- All-hands slate proposed (1.25h): product direction (25m), customer stories (10m), ops/infra roadmap + SLA progress (15m), team spotlights (15m), AMA + actions (20m).

Draft OKRs (candidate, measurable, owner):
1) Objective: Reduce per-token serving cost for mid-tail workloads to make price-performance competitive with managed alternatives.
   - KR1.1: Achieve 18% reduction in average token cost on hosted API for sequences 0-1024. (Owner: Priya Shah)
   - KR1.2: Pilot quantization profiles on Dedicated across 3 highest-volume models, with <3% quality delta on eval prompts. (Owner: Applied ML)
   - KR1.3: Deploy prefix-KV caching to 5 top-enterprise routes and realize 10% latency improvement at 95th percentile. (Owner: Serving Runtime)

2) Objective: Make Dedicated capacity onboarding <30 days for mid-market customers and <14 days for pilot customers.
   - KR2.1: Create and ship a turnkey infra template + runbook covering networking, KMS, and SLA guardrails. (Owner: Private Deployments / Infra)
   - KR2.2: Reduce manual steps in onboarding by automating 4 major checklist items (DNS, certificate, quota config, monitoring hook). (Owner: Solutions Eng)
   - KR2.3: Complete 6 Dedicated onboarding pilots and capture time-to-first-inference metric for each. (Owner: Customer Success)

3) Objective: Improve reliability signal and customer trust for Private deployments.
   - KR3.1: Offer a 99.9% uptime SLA for Private customers that pass the onboarding checklist; collect 30-day baseline. (Owner: SRE)
   - KR3.2: Launch audit-log and KMS integration templates for 3 major cloud providers. (Owner: Security & Compliance)

Milestones and 30/60/90 schedule (high level):
- Week 0-4 (30): OKR finalization, slide templates for all-hands, runbook skeleton for Dedicated onboarding, begin quantization pilots.
- Week 5-8 (60): Internal beta of caching and batching configs, first Dedicated infra template in staging, SRE reliability baseline reporting, draft customer case study (pilot #1).
- Week 9-12 (90): Ship turnkey Dedicated onboarding template, publish all-hands recording + followups, roll quantization to production on one model, iterate on SLA wording for Private.

All-hands proposed slate (60-75 min):
- Opening narrative (CEO / Founders) 7 min: One-sentence northstar + why this quarter matters to customers.
- Product deep (Head of Product) 20-25 min: Short demo of new routing/caching behavior + cost impact slide (concrete delta).
- Customer story (CS or Solutions Eng) 8-10 min: Show pilot onboarding timeline and measurable outcomes.
- Infra & Reliability (SRE lead) 12-15 min: P95 latency trend, incident postmortems gains, Dedicated capacity roadmap.
- Team spotlights (2–3 small teams) 12 min: Quick wins, hiring asks.
- AMA + concrete asks (executive panel) 15–20 min: Collect actions; close with three company-level asks (see bottom).

Comms and pre-reads:
- One-pager to staff (to be emailed 48 hours before all-hands) with TL;DR OKRs and top-line metrics. Draft lines below.
- Confluence pre-read: link to OKR doc (placeholder above). Ask managers to annotate three bullet outcomes in comments.
- Public-facing blog: schedule a short post after all-hands focusing on product advances that impact customer costs. (Marketing lead: Samira)

Exec update outline (for weekly exec slot leading to all-hands):
- 3-slide pack: 1) Northstar + sprint focus; 2) measurable deltas vs last quarter (latency, cost, onboarding days); 3) major risks & mitigations + asks.
- Asks to execs this week: 1) approve Dedicated onboarding runbook, 2) sign off new SLA language for Private pilot, 3) approve pilot customer list and go/no-go thresholds.

Risk register (top 6 and mitigations):
- Risk A: Quantization quality regressions on multimodal tails. Mitigation: staged eval harness + rollback flag per model. (Owner: Applied ML)
- Risk B: Onboarding timeline slips due to customer infra variability. Mitigation: add a "pilot scaffold" checklist and reserve solutions eng hours. (Owner: Solutions Eng)
- Risk C: SRE bandwidth for Dedicated increases leading to slower incident response. Mitigation: temporary on-call augmentation + runbook automation. (Owner: SRE)
- Risk D: Messaging leak causing customer churn fear. Mitigation: alignment with marketing + legal, carefully worded FAQs, training for CS. (Owner: Marketing + Legal)

Staffing and hiring notes (quick):
- Short-term priority hires: 1 Senior Applied ML infra engineer (quantization/ops), 1 Dedicated onboarding engineer (Solutions Eng), 1 SRE with private-deploy experience.
- Reallocate one IC from console features to onboarding automation for 8 weeks (proposal: Kai Thompson).

Concrete asks for leaders (actionable items to close before all-hands):
- Product: prepare a 5-slide demo + cost slide. (Due: 2026-02-24)
- SRE: publish p95 baseline and incident trend chart. (Due: 2026-02-24)
- CS: confirm two pilot customers and a short success narrative. (Due: 2026-02-26)
- Marketing: draft staff-facing one-pager and post-all-hands blog outline. (Due: 2026-02-25)

Open questions & notes-to-self (rough):
- Should we compress all-hands to 45 minutes and move deep-dive to follow-up office hours? Pros: shorter all-staff time; Cons: loses narrative momentum. Need founder input.
- Do we publish OKRs externally? Likely high-level only — discuss with legal/marketing.
- Need to pull list of top 10 routes by token volume for caching pilot (INF-4123 is tracking).

Next steps (immediate 72h):
1) Circulate this doc to execs for 48h review (Avery).
2) Product & SRE: quick sync to align p95 and cost delta numbers (Priya + SRE lead).
3) Draft email + pre-read for managers (Samira).
4) Create a Confluence child page with OKR editable table and ask managers to nominate owners for KRs.

Quick communication lines (staff one-pager draft):
- Headline: "This quarter: making inference predictable and affordable for customers."
- Key bullets (3): 1) Major investment on Dedicated templates to shorten onboarding; 2) Runtime improvements to lower token costs; 3) Reliability upgrades and clearer SLAs for private deployments.
- Close: "In the all-hands we'll share the plan and the concrete asks — please come with questions and your team's top 1 blocker."

Appendix (links & artifacts):
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Northstar+Thread
- Jira pilot tracking: INF-4123
- Release PR for onboarding template: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/274

I expect iterations — this is intentionally compact. Comments inline or on the Confluence child page please.

---
Notes: rough language, leave placeholders for numbers where we are waiting on SRE/Product metrics. Use the linked artifacts for deeper context.
